title: The Widower: 'Til Death Do Us Part
original_title: The Widower: 'Til Death Do Us Part
plot_overview: A journalist and a detective investigate a charming man whose string of failed marriages and suspicious deaths raises troubling questions. As they examine the history surrounding his wives, the pair pursue answers in a case that challenges their understanding of what happened.
will_you_like_this: You’ll like this if you enjoy focused true-crime documentaries about persistent investigations and unsettling cases, especially titles like The Menendez Brothers; Not for you if you prefer light viewing or a less bleak story.
review_summary: Pros: compelling true-crime story; determined investigation; concise and informative | Cons: bleak subject matter; occasional tonal oddness; feels tightly packed
